_comment: Factory budgets + caps SIZED TO UNIT ECONOMICS. 1 client pays $200/mo, so paid-API spend must stay a small fraction. Real measured spend ~$1.43/mo, so these have big headroom AND force max-free-min-paid: if a nightly run approaches the cap, make it cheaper (fewer Haiku/paid calls), do NOT raise the cap. daily cap = no single NIGHT can burst (every paid call gates on budget.can_spend; at the cap paid calls are DENIED, factory keeps running on free routes). Raise proportionally as PAYING clients are added (~10-15% of each client's fee). kill_switch_paid_spend=true = emergency brake.
